additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition and maps StructureDefinition to sdf, confirming build scope. FHIR-13721 is the same root-versus-first issue for sdf-9 but was not needed for this seed decision. FHIR-20391 later corrected the companion sdf-20 XPath and is already represented on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the current active source already implements the requested sdf-20 root-element FHIRPath expression, and editing frozen historical release snapshots would not be a current-spec correction.
